faults.name: delay_no_shift
faults.why: the sample leaving one engine's segment does not reach the next engine (folded variants with more than one MAC)

faults.name: acc_not_cleared
faults.why: each output adds onto the last one's partial sums

faults.name: sweep_wrong_way
faults.why: the delay line is read forwards, so the taps meet the wrong samples

faults.name: coef_wrong_field
faults.why: a coefficient is written into the field of the wrong MAC engine

faults.name: sample_with_coef
faults.why: a sample offered beside a coefficient beat is acknowledged and then dropped

faults.name: ram_one_read_register
faults.why: the RAM's read latency drops to one clock, so data and the MAC pipeline flags are a clock apart

faults.name: product_unsigned
faults.why: the LUT multipliers treat negative samples as large positive ones

faults.name: delay_line_broadcast
faults.why: every tap sees the previous sample instead of its own delay

faults.name: latency_declared_short
faults.why: the declared LATENCY no longer matches the clocks the folded variants take, so a caller reading it would be wrong
